label: GeneratorDeviceState
info:
Reads Generator Device State from registers:
- 512-513: Runtime totals (32-bit)
- 536-539: Daily energy/time
- 609: Frequency
- 661-671: 3-phase voltage + power (32-bit power values)

Triggers:
1. Periodic: Every 5 minutes (only sends if generator active)
2. Manual
3. RPC: getGeneratorDeviceState (always sends response)

name: Route to 4 reads
Prepare read (Runtime 512-513)
Prepare read (Daily 536-539)
Prepare read (Freq 609)
Prepare read (Voltage/Power 661-671)
Build GeneratorDeviceState JSON
Check if should send
Poll 5min (sends if active) + Manual + RPC (always) - 4 parallel reads with 32-bit power
